title: UFCPS Procedural State Transition Specification
description: Machine-readable transition contract for the Step Continuity Protocol (SCP). Defines the structural representation of a transition from one procedural state to another within a continuous distributed cognitive process.
$comment: This schema validates the structural representation of a transition. It does not by itself prove semantic correctness, mathematical validity, convergence, or successful execution. Cross-field transition rules such as destination_step = source_step + 1 and consistency between carrier_changed and carrier identifiers require runtime validation.

transition_id.description: Unique identifier of the recorded transition event.

transition_type.description: Classification of the transition represented by this record.

source_procedural_unit.description: Reference data for the procedural unit before the transition.

step_index.description: Sequential index of the source procedural unit.

carrier_id.description: Identifier of the carrier executing the source procedural unit.

carrier_type.description: Technology or architecture profile of the source carrier.

session_status.description: SCP execution phase of the source procedural unit.

state_reference.description: Reference or serialized representation of the source procedural state.

operation.description: Canonical operation responsible for the recorded transition.

destination_procedural_unit.description: Reference data for the procedural unit after the transition.

step_index.description: Sequential index of the destination procedural unit. For a standard continuation transition, runtime validation should require this value to equal source step_index + 1.

carrier_id.description: Identifier of the carrier executing the destination procedural unit.

carrier_type.description: Technology or architecture profile of the destination carrier.

session_status.description: SCP execution phase of the destination procedural unit.

state_reference.description: Reference or serialized representation of the destination procedural state.

carrier_transition.description: Explicit description of whether the procedural carrier changed during the transition.

changed.description: Indicates whether the source and destination procedural units have different carriers.

reason.description: Optional structural reason for carrier replacement or retention.

continuation_state.description: Continuation-relevant state required to reconstruct the destination procedural unit.

state_preserved.description: Indicates that the continuation-relevant state has been preserved in the transition record.

state_reference.description: Reference to the preserved handoff state or serialized continuation state.

unresolved_difference.description: Unresolved difference carried into the next procedural state.

next_required_operation.description: Operation required to construct the next valid procedural state.

validation.description: Recorded validation results for the transition. These values report validation performed elsewhere; the schema does not establish their truth.

schema_valid.description: True when the transition record conforms to the applicable JSON Schema.

process_rule_valid.description: True when an external SCP validator confirms that the source and destination states form an allowed protocol transition.

continuation_valid.description: True when an external validator confirms that enough continuation-relevant information is preserved.

runtime_validation_note.description: Optional description of runtime checks, exceptions, or unresolved validation conditions.

timestamp.description: Optional machine-readable timestamp for the transition event.
